title: Walking Back To My Roots
text:
Walking Back To My Roots is a travel expedition undertaken by two undergraduate students of IIT Kharagpur. Siddharth Agarwal along with Ashay Gangwar walked 600 km across Rajasthan during December 2014, as a part of their efforts to highlight social issues and initiate cultural revival throughout the country. The duo managed to raise around 30,000 for Rang De campaign.

 See also 
* The Madness Project
